_comment: Three defects. (1) The trigger was START_OF_TURN; the card says 'at the beginning of your ACTION PHASE' (CR 4.3.1), which is later. (2) 'Your NEXT attack this turn gets +1{p}' was MODIFY_ATTACK with an unread duration -- MODIFY_ATTACK mutates the CURRENT combat, and there is none at the start of a phase, so it did nothing; as a turn-long effect it would instead buff every attack for the rest of the turn. MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK is the one-shot, and it already expires with the turn, which is why no duration is needed. (3) Go again is a printed keyword here, not an activated ability with a cost.
